title: My common fees

autopay.title: Auto-pay
autopay.lede: Advance common-fee bills (quarterly, half-yearly or yearly) of {unit}

methodBody.direct_debit: Debited from your account when a bill is issued
methodBody.card_token: Charged to your card when a bill is issued

autopay.how: The payment provider's page opens for you to confirm. After that each advance bill is charged once when it is issued. Cancel at any time.
autopay.activeBody: On since {date}. Advance bills are charged when issued.
autopay.pendingBody: Waiting for you to confirm on the payment provider's page

unavailable.title: Not offered in this building yet
unavailable.body: This building has no auto-pay yet. Pay with the PromptPay QR or attach a slip as usual.

cancel.title: Cancel auto-pay?
cancel.body: Bills from now on are not charged automatically; pay them with the QR or a slip.

payFirst: Each unit has its own bill. Pay one at a time, starting with {unit}, which is due first.

empty.title: No common-fee bills yet
empty.body: When the juristic person issues a bill you'll get a LINE message, and you can pay it here.

paper.title: Common fees, {period}
paper.totalDue: {count, plural, =1 {Amount to pay} other {Amount to pay, # bills}}

due.soon: Due {date} · in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
due.late: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} past due · due {date}

documents.title: Documents and money
documents.statementsNone: The juristic office sends one at the start of each month
documents.planBody: Split what you owe into monthly instalments

statements.title: Monthly statements
statements.lede: Brought forward, charges, payments and the amount to pay for all your units
statements.emptyBody: The juristic office sends a statement at the start of each month; you'll get a LINE message.
statements.nothingDueBody: Nothing to pay on this statement.

plans.title: Payment plan
plans.askBody: Ask the juristic office to split what this unit owes into monthly instalments. Once approved, each instalment comes with your monthly bill.
plans.sentBody: The juristic office will review it and tell you in LINE. You can withdraw it meanwhile.

decided.rejected: The office did not approve this plan
decided.rejectedBody: Contact the juristic office to talk about other options.
decided.defaultedBody: An instalment went past its due date, so the rest is on your next bill.

plans.proposedNote: Instalment amounts are as requested; the office confirms them when it approves.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this request?
withdraw.body: The office will not review it. What you owe stays the same, and you can ask again later.

form.title: Ask for a payment plan
form.openExists: This unit already has a plan
form.openExistsBody: A unit can have one open plan at a time.
form.nothingDueBody: This unit has nothing to pay right now.
form.instalmentsHint: Monthly, at least 2. The office sets the most it allows.
form.instalmentsRange: Monthly, {min}–{max} instalments as the office allows.
form.firstDueHint: Left empty, the first instalment is due on the 1st of next month.
form.firstDueWindow: Left empty, the first instalment is due on {date} · latest {latest}.
form.noteHint: For example the reason, or when paying suits you
form.how: The juristic office reviews it and tells you in LINE. When approved, what you owe at that time is split into the instalments.

firstDueOn.late: Choose a date no later than {date}

clearance.title: Debt clearance certificate
clearance.askTitle: Ask for a debt clearance certificate
clearance.askBody: For the ownership transfer at the land office. Issued at once when this unit has nothing to pay on the day you choose.
clearance.issuedBody: This unit has nothing to pay as of {date}.
clearance.codeOnce: Verification code (shown once; the buyer or the land office can check it):
clearance.requestedBody: This certificate has a fee of {fee}, which comes on your next bill. Once it is paid the office issues the certificate.
clearance.refusedTitle: The office did not issue this certificate
clearance.refusedBody: Contact the juristic office to ask why.

share.text: Debt clearance certificate {number} · {unit} · as of {date} · valid until {valid}

outcome.copied: Text copied; paste it in a chat
outcome.opened: File opened; save or share it from there

outstanding.title: The certificate can't be issued yet
outstanding.body: {unit} still has an amount to pay as of {date}
outstanding.bodyNoAmount: {unit} still has an amount to pay as of {date}
outstanding.next: Pay it in full, then ask again; the certificate is issued at once. This request was not kept.
outstanding.plan: Ask for a payment plan instead

form.title: Ask for the certificate
form.asOf: As of (for example the transfer day)
form.how: We check this unit's balance on the day you choose. If there is nothing to pay, the certificate is issued at once with a verification code.
